programs.title: Fortress
programs.desc: Robert, a retired CIA agent lives at a secret resort in the woods. One day, his estranged son drives to him for a visit, and is unknowingly followed by his dad’s old nemesis.

programs.title: Detective Knight: Rogue
programs.desc: When masked robbers critically wound his partner during a heist, detective James Knight pursues them from Los Angeles to New York, where his past threatens to destroy him.

programs.title: Basic
programs.desc: A DEA agent investigates the disappearance of a legendary Army ranger drill sergeant and several of his cadets during a training exercise gone severely awry.

programs.title: Mr. Right
programs.desc: After a breakup, hyperactive Martha is looking to do something terrible when she meets Francis, who seems to be perfect, except he's a professional assassin.
